name: lidar-wasm
description: WebAssembly bindings for lidar-rs: nested surface depression and mount delineation, hydro-conditioning, and inundation simulation in browsers and Node.js (zero GDAL)

scripts.build:web: wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir pkg -- --locked && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('pkg/.gitignore',{force:true}); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('pkg/package.json','utf8')); p.type='module'; fs.writeFileSync('pkg/package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n');"
scripts.build:node: wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release --out-dir pkg-node -- --locked && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('pkg-node/.gitignore',{force:true}); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('pkg-node/package.json','utf8')); p.type='commonjs'; fs.writeFileSync('pkg-node/package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n');"
scripts.build:bundler: wasm-pack build --target bundler --release --out-dir pkg-bundler -- --locked && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('pkg-bundler/.gitignore',{force:true}); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('pkg-bundler/package.json','utf8')); p.type='module'; fs.writeFileSync('pkg-bundler/package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n');"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:node && npm run build:bundler
